hook.description: Low-angle medium close-up of Lady Juliana standing erect in the dock, her prisoner label pinned to her rustic buttoned gown, her expression resolute.
hook.evidence: The visual of a woman in a prisoner's dock immediately establishes high stakes and a 'wrongfully accused' narrative.

candidates.reason: The rapid escalation from the accusation to the judge slamming his gavel creates immediate tension.

hook.description: Lady Juliana slams her cuffed hands against the wooden railing of the dock, her voice ringing out in indignant fury.
hook.evidence: The physical outburst of a prisoner fighting back against false testimony is a classic, high-energy hook.

candidates.reason: The betrayal by the maid followed by the townspeople turning on her creates a 'world against one' dynamic.

hook.description: Close-up of Lady Juliana lifting her chin without an ounce of hesitation.
hook.evidence: The visual of a defiant protagonist refusing to break under pressure is highly engaging for viewers.

candidates.reason: Her powerful declaration that she will not call healing evil despite the threat of death is a strong emotional payoff.
